**One gateway owns every conversation** — Before, the CLI, TUI, Desktop, editors (ACP), messaging bots and cron could each run their own copy of the agent against the same chat, which is how messages got written twice or went missing between surfaces. Now each machine runs one gateway that owns every session, and every surface attaches to it as a client: a chat you open anywhere is the same chat, with one queue and one history. You can even steer or edit a queued prompt from Desktop without it r
